subject.title: [Bug]: sessions_list API only returns main session — all other sessions missing from dashboard and API

question: Should literal `session.store` paths that match `agents/<id>/sessions/sessions.json` be treated as same-root multi-agent discovery roots, or should literal paths remain single-store isolation by default?
rationale: The fix path is clear, but changing literal path semantics can affect existing user configurations that may have relied on literal file isolation.

options.title: Accept same-root discovery
options.body: Resolve the conflict and land the linked fix with maintainer-visible upgrade context for the changed literal path behavior.

options.title: Preserve literal isolation
options.body: Require a default-preserving implementation that widens discovery only through an explicit template, migration, or documented opt-in.

options.title: Replace the stale branch
options.body: Keep this issue open and replace the conflicting PR with a fresh narrow maintainer repair carrying the accepted semantics.

recommendation.title: Accept same-root discovery
recommendation.body: Resolve the conflict and land the linked fix with maintainer-visible upgrade context for the changed literal path behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is prior multi-agent/session-store ownership plus broad central-file ownership for this path.
